The Purdon Charcoal Westbury Suit is a beautiful iteration of our tailoring principles, merging a refined sartorial aesthetic with a relaxed, effortless character. Crafted from a soft and lightweight wool blend, this ensemble features a subtle Purdon chalkstripe set against a rich charcoal backdrop, making it a versatile pillar for your autumn and winter wardrobe.
The Westbury jacket is a single-breasted, two-button style defined by its broad notch lapels. We have kept the construction completely unstructured to afford a fluid feel and a natural drape that settles beautifully on the body. It brings a quiet sense of authority to your work wardrobe through the week, yet feels easy enough to style casually with a knit over the weekend.
Completing the suit, our Orsman trousers offer a modern reference to wide-leg tailoring. Designed with a structured wide leg and single front pleats, they give the shape a clean, sartorial line without ever feeling overly formal. Whether worn together as a sharp, contemporary chalkstripe suit or split into distinct separates, this charcoal combination will do you proud on any occasion.
